instruction:
Load /home/user/Desktop/lower.step and /home/user/Desktop/upper.step in BRL-CAD. Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `lower.step`.

Place the 50 x 35 x 20 mm upper block at the center of the top face of the 105 x 80 x 10 mm lower plate and fuse them. Cut a central top blind pocket of 30 x 20 x 8 mm in the upper block. Cut four through holes of diameter 6 mm in the lower plate corners, each hole center 12 mm from the nearest two sides. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl.
